# Aditya Arya

> I’m currently serving in the Singapore Army. I’m also designing and building projects of my own.

## Work

- [Catch SG Buses](https://apps.apple.com/sg/app/catch-sg-buses/id6777373130): A bus timing app for Singapore.
- [Designing Catch](https://adiarya.com/work/catch): The story behind Catch, including bus timings, leave-now guidance and Live Activities.
- [Designing Soja](https://adiarya.com/work/soja): A sleep recovery app that turns circadian timing into a daily plan.
- [Designing the WayAuto icon](https://adiarya.com/work/wayauto): An app icon for an automatic driving log, from aerial road studies to an editable Icon Composer project.
- [Selected work](https://adiarya.com/work): Apps, interfaces, websites and motion studies.
